rationale: Extends the proven recurrent-tail export budget slightly by keeping `attn.c_v.weight` in fp16 for every recurrent tail block, not just the final block. This is a compact change on top of the current best family and directly targets the final int8+zlib roundtrip path, where recurrent value-path quantization noise remains a plausible bottleneck.
title: Recurrent-Tail V Float Rescue
